_comment: Machine settings for this PC. Copy this file to machine.json (gitignored) and change what
differs here; null means 'use the default'. Environment variables win over this file:
HASTYCR_DATA, HASTYCR_RUNS, HASTYCR_MUMU_MANAGER. Check the result with:
Paths: forward slashes, or double every backslash. Relative paths start at the repo root.
adb: null finds adb on PATH, then MuMu's own shell\adb.exe under Program Files\Netease.
Prefer MuMu's own: two adb versions restart each other's server. To list them:
